variants.headline: Company lays off many workers
variants.body: The company {company} has laid off many workers. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: A large loss of jobs at a company
variants.body: Many workers have been laid off by {company}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Workers face a company layoff
variants.body: The company {company} has carried out a large layoff. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
